text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...! I won♪
I actually won! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The race is already over,
but my heart won't stop pounding...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The cheers the moment we crossed the finish line! The heat in the Winner's Circle! Everything was just truly incredible...!!
choice_data_list: I'm expecting great things from you next time too.
I'm expecting great things from you next time too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The cheers the moment we crossed the finish line! The heat in the Winner's Circle! Everything was just truly incredible...!!
choice_data_list: I'm expecting great things from you next time too.
I'm expecting great things from you next time too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Today's race is something
I'm sure I will never, ever forget...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Winning was wonderful, of course,
but the experience of seeing it through together with you
is what I'll truly treasure the most.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know♪ Let's take a photo for the memories!
Umm, let me bring up the front camera... and done.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, over here ♪
Would you come sit next to me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Looking at this photo, I feel like I'll be able
to vividly remember today no matter how many years pass♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I managed to take a wonderful commemorative photo
with a very happy-looking Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's win the next one too!
To do that, we can't let our guard down and must keep improving♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And on that note... It might be a bit sudden,
but do you mind if I train once we get back?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: While the feel of the race is still fresh, there are a few things I'd like to review.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Now then, let us aim for glorious victory next time as well...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a dignified gaze,
Fine Motion was already looking ahead to the next stage.
